en.description:
Snow Rush 3D brings fast, responsive single and multiplayer downhill skiing to Apple Watch in a way that feels smooth, exciting, and instantly fun using only Apple Digital Crown Control.

Race through snowy mountains, avoid trees and hazards, master sharp turns, and push your reflexes to the limit. Play a progressive campaign with increasing difficulty, jump into quick downhill runs, or compete against real players in international multiplayer events.

Every session is designed for quick gameplay bursts while still delivering progression, challenge, and replayability.

Why players love it:

True 3D skiing gameplay optimized for Apple Watch
Smooth arcade downhill action with intuitive Digital Crown controls
Multiple skiers and gear to unlock with unique stats and handling
Diverse snowy tracks filled with jumps, turns, and obstacles
Multiplayer competition against real opponents
Designed for fast, addictive sessions anywhere

Whether you have 30 seconds or 10 minutes, Snow Rush 3D delivers an exciting downhill skiing experience directly on your wrist.

Minimum: Apple Watch Series 8 or later
Recommended device: Apple Watch Series 9 or later.
en.releaseNotes:
- 3 new maps
- country flag cosmetic  in multiplayer
- name tags for multiplayer opponents
- free energy increased to 7
- air control
en.subtitle: Multiplayer 3D Ski Game
